reading.title: RESOLUTION R-2025-17 Sales tax rebate for Larkspur Commons

candidates.quote: The Board finds that Larkspur Community Builders, Inc. proposes 64 homes on Orchard Road, and that the builder has asked for help with the cost of building materials.
candidates.value: help with cost of building materials

candidates.quote: The Village Board approves a rebate of the Village share of sales tax on building materials for Larkspur Commons, not to exceed $350,000.
The rebate is paid only while each condition in Exhibit A is met.
candidates.value: rebate paid only while conditions are met

candidates.quote: The Village Administrator shall report to the Board each year on whether the conditions are met.
Sixteen of the sixty-four homes are rented at restricted rents.
Each of those homes is rented to a household at or below fifty percent of area median income.
candidates.value: at or below 50% of area median income

candidates.quote: The restrictions stay in place until at least January 1, 2066.
The builder gives the Village a yearly list of the restricted homes and the rents charged.
candidates.value: yearly list of restricted homes and rents
